calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-04-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of two minors.
Dept. 514, Judge: Paul Alvarado, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.
Petitioner/Mother Jiao Deng Li present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad Litem for the minors Li Ling Ye and Bing Yan Ye. Co-Petitioner/Father Jian Quan Ye also present in court. Petitioners were placed under oath and testified.
Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of an Adult to Kelli Ye and change name of the minors to Lily Ye and Simon Ye.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
